Commercial Emergency & Backflow Services

Account holders move to the front of the line, and we keep your backflow assemblies tested and current.

Get a Quote Call 803-600-4357

What It Is

When a business has a plumbing emergency, every hour costs money. Account holders get priority dispatch, and we also test and repair the backflow assemblies that keep your water supply protected.

Signs You Need It

  • A burst line, flooding or a sewage backup on site
  • No water to restrooms or the kitchen
  • Backflow test due for your building
  • A failed or leaking backflow assembly

What To Expect

Call 803-600-4357 and we'll get a tech moving. On site, we stop the damage, make the repair and send updates from the field while the work is underway. Backflow work is scheduled around your hours where we can.

Commercial Services

What We Handle

  • Priority Emergency Dispatch

    Account holders move to the front of the line when something breaks. We get a tech on the way and keep your contact updated until the problem is under control.

    What's included

    • Priority scheduling for account holders
    • Emergency line for urgent calls
    • Updates from the field
    • Repair and documentation for your records

    Common signs you need this

    • Water where it shouldn't be
    • Restrooms or kitchen out of service
    • Sewage backing up into the building
    Get a Quote

  • Backflow Testing

    Backflow assemblies keep used or contaminated water from flowing back into the clean supply. We test them and give you paperwork for your records.

    What's included

    • Testing of backflow assemblies
    • Paperwork for your records
    • Notes on any parts that need attention
    • Scheduling around your hours where we can

    Common signs you need this

    • Annual test coming due
    • Notice from your water provider
    • New assembly that needs an initial test
    Get a Quote

  • Backflow Repair & Installation

    When an assembly fails its test or starts leaking, we repair it or replace it. We also install new assemblies for new service or added equipment.

    What's included

    • Repairing failed assemblies
    • Replacing worn or leaking units
    • New assembly installation
    • Retest after repair

    Common signs you need this

    • Failed backflow test
    • Water leaking from the assembly
    • Adding equipment that requires protection
    Get a Quote

  • Shutoff & Leak Control

    The first step in any emergency is stopping the water. We isolate the problem so the rest of the building can keep running while we repair it.

    What's included

    • Locating and operating shutoff valves
    • Isolating the affected area
    • Temporary measures to limit damage
    • Permanent repair

    Common signs you need this

    • Active leak you can't stop
    • Shutoff valves that won't close fully
    Get a Quote
